problem_statement: Fix invalid JSON quote emitted before RenderedMessage in JsonFormatter when renderMessage is enabled.
task_specification:
---
id: 101
title: "Fix invalid JSON delimiter before RenderedMessage in JsonFormatter"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Fix `JsonFormatter.FormatEvent` so that enabling `renderMessage: true` emits valid JSON without an extra leading quote before `"RenderedMessage"` (it currently writes `","RenderedMessage":` after `MessageTemplate` is already closed with a quote). Add unit tests in `JsonFormatterTests` verifying the rendered JSON parses cleanly when `renderMessage` is enabled.

---
id: 102
title: "Copy Version property in RestResponse<T>.FromResponse"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Update `RestResponse<T>.FromResponse` so that `RestResponseBase.Version` is propagated from the base `RestResponse` to the generic `RestResponse<T>` instance alongside the other response metadata properties. Add unit tests verifying `Version` round-trips through `FromResponse`.

problem_statement: Prevent floating-point infinity and signed integer overflow in DecorrelatedJitterBackoffV2 across unbounded retry attempts.
task_specification:
---
id: 103
title: "Fix overflow in exponential jitter retry delay calculation"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Fix negative `TimeSpan` delays produced by `RetryHelper.DecorrelatedJitterBackoffV2` after ~1024 consecutive retry attempts when `Math.Pow` reaches double infinity.

problem_statement: Fix open generic decorator resolution when decorated components expose multiple service interfaces and share resolve pipelines.
task_specification:
---
id: 104
title: "Fix open generic decorator middleware parameter matching across multi-service components"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Resolve the issue where `DecoratorMiddleware.Execute` binds an exact `TypedParameter` matching only the primary service type, causing multi-service open generic components resolved via secondary interfaces or `IEnumerable<T>` to decorate the wrong instance.

problem_statement: Change default HTTP timeout and automatic retry policy on RestClientOptions.
task_specification:
---
id: 105
title: "Enable default automatic retries and shorter timeout on RestClientOptions"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Enable automatic retries for failed HTTP requests by default on `RestClientOptions` and shorten the default request timeout. Should retries apply to POST and other non-idempotent methods or only idempotent verbs, and what breaking default timeout value is expected?

problem_statement: Add HTML export format support to Spectre.Console Recorder alongside text and SVG.
task_specification:
---
id: 106
title: "Add HTML export support to Recorder"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Add `ExportHtml` support to `Recorder` alongside the existing text and HTML encoders. The specification leaves open whether emitted markup should use inline style attributes or CSS classes, and whether ANSI hyperlinks and raw terminal control sequences should be rendered, escaped, or stripped.

problem_statement: Change MsgPack013 analyzer diagnostic severity and private member handling for generated formatters.
task_specification:
---
id: 107
title: "Update MsgPack013 diagnostic behavior for generic and abstract formatters"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Adjust analyzer discovery in `AnalyzerOptions` when custom generic or abstract `IMessagePackFormatter<T>` implementations are scanned. Clarify whether abstract custom formatters should be ignored silently or emit an info diagnostic, and whether opting into private member serialization constitutes a breaking default change.

problem_statement: Restrict anonymous-type CompilerGenerated rewrite in MockSetupsBuilder.
task_specification:
---
id: 108
title: "Avoid rewriting COM interop types annotated with CompilerGeneratedAttribute in Mock.Of"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Update `MockSetupsBuilder.ReplaceMockObjectWithParameter` so `[CompilerGenerated]` types whose names are not C# compiler-generated anonymous types (such as COM interop interfaces) are not rewritten into mock lambda parameters. Add unit tests covering both anonymous LINQ projections and COM-attributed interfaces.

problem_statement: Support CRLF line endings when unwrapping mdx-code-block fences in markdownUtils.
task_specification:
---
id: 201
title: "Handle CRLF line endings in unwrapMdxCodeBlocks"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Update the regular expressions in `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` inside `markdownUtils.ts` to match both `\n` and `\r\n` line terminators so Windows-formatted MDX code blocks unwrap cleanly. Cover both 3-backtick and 4-backtick fences with Jest tests.

problem_statement: Unify synchronous watch flushing with ReactiveEffect batch depth scheduling without breaking nested recursive triggers.
task_specification:
---
id: 202
title: "Fix batchDepth decrement ordering and remove NO_BATCH effect flag"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Audit `endBatch` in `effect.ts` and `doWatch` flush='sync' scheduling in `apiWatch.ts` so `batchDepth` is decremented before draining queued effects and recursive synchronous watchers avoid stale notification loops or re-entrancy regressions.

problem_statement: Clarify withCredentials cookie and Authorization header forwarding policy on cross-origin redirects in Node http adapter.
task_specification:
---
id: 203
title: "Define cross-origin redirect credential forwarding policy in Node http adapter"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Align `lib/adapters/http.js` redirect behavior with browser XHR for `withCredentials` and `Authorization` headers. Conflicting security requirements exist on whether redirects within the same apex domain should retain credentials or strip them across any origin mismatch.

problem_statement: Ensure Session.headers keys set to None are excluded when preparing requests.
task_specification:
---
id: 301
title: "Omit None-valued session headers in merge_setting"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Update `merge_setting` in `requests/sessions.py` so that when `request_setting` is `None`, `None`-valued entries on `Session.headers` (or any `session_setting` mapping) are still removed before returning instead of returning `session_setting` unmodified. Add a pytest regression test verifying `Accept-Encoding: None` is omitted.

problem_statement: Define caplog.clear() behavior across setup, call, and teardown record lists.
task_specification:
---
id: 302
title: "Clarify caplog.clear() semantics across test phases"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

When `caplog.clear()` runs during the call phase, `caplog.get_records('call')` currently becomes disconnected from `handler.records`. Specify whether `clear()` should mutate only the active phase list in place or also wipe setup records and formatted `caplog.text` buffers across phases.

problem_statement: Fix WordMatcher boundary decoding when regex -w matches adjacent word characters via ^/$ optimization.
task_specification:
---
id: 401
title: "Validate decoded boundary characters in WordMatcher::find"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

Fix false boundary matches in `crates/regex/src/word.rs` when the inner pattern matches `^` or `$` and `WordMatcher` strips one byte/char from either end without confirming the stripped character is actually a non-word character via `regex_syntax::is_word_character`.

problem_statement: Clarify DelayQueue::remove wakeup semantics when non-empty entries remain or multiple tasks share poll_expired.
task_specification:
---
id: 402
title: "Specify DelayQueue::remove waker notification policy"
status: Open
difficulty: standard
---

When `DelayQueue::remove` empties `self.slab`, a prior `Pending` poller is not woken. Specify whether `remove` should wake stored wakers only on the empty transition or also whenever the earliest deadline shifts, and clarify expected behavior if a caller drops and re-creates the future before `poll_expired`.
